description: This file contains utility functions and constants for parsing command-line arguments related to test execution, including option recognition, argument filtering, and counting specific test filters.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses a list of command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments, handling special cases such as '--' and options that require a value.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of file filter arguments provided after the command, or returns null if none are provided.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of file filter arguments from the command-line arguments.
